lines.gurmukhi: ਪਹਿਲਾ ਫਾਹਾ ਪਇਆ ਪਾਧੇ ਪਿਛੋ ਦੇ ਗਲਿ ਚਾਟੜਿਆ ॥੫॥
lines.transliteration: pahilaa phaahaa paiaa paadhe pichho de gal chaataRiaa ||5||
lines.translation: First, the teacher is tied down, and then, the noose is placed around the pupil's neck. ||5||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਸੈ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਗਇਓ ਮੂੜੇ ਏਕੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਕੁਥਾਇ ਲਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sasai sa(n)jam gaio mooRe ek daan tudh kuthaai laiaa ||
lines.translation: Sassa: You have lost your self-discipline, you fool, and you have accepted an offering under false pretenses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰੀ ਜਜਮਾਨ ਕੀ ਸਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਏਤੁ ਧਾਨਿ ਖਾਧੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਇਆ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: saaee putree jajamaan kee saa teree et dhaan khaadhai teraa janam gaiaa ||6||
lines.translation: The daughter of the alms-giver is just like your own; by accepting this payment for performing the wedding ceremony, you have cursed your own life. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਮੈ ਮਤਿ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਡਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)mai mat hir laee teree mooRe haumai vadaa rog paiaa ||
lines.translation: Mamma: You have been cheated out your intellect, you fool, and you are afflicted with the great disease of ego.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨ ਚੀਨੑਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar aatamai braham na cheenhiaa maaiaa kaa muhataaj bhaiaa ||7||
lines.translation: Within your innermost self, you do not recognize God, and you compromise yourself for the sake of Maya. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਕੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਕ੍ਰੋਧਿ ਭਰਮਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਮਤਾ ਲਾਗੇ ਤੁਧੁ ਹਰਿ ਵਿਸਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kakai kaam krodh bharamiohu mooRe mamataa laage tudh har visariaa ||
lines.translation: Kakka: You wander around in sexual desire and anger, you fool; attached to possessiveness, you have forgotten the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਹਿ ਗੁਣਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਪੁਕਾਰਹਿ ਵਿਣੁ ਬੂਝੇ ਤੂੰ ਡੂਬਿ ਮੁਆ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: paRahi gunahi too(n) bahut pukaarahi vin boojhe too(n) doob muaa ||8||
lines.translation: You read, and reflect, and proclaim out loud, but without understanding, you are drowned to death. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੈ ਤਾਮਸਿ ਜਲਿਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਥਥੈ ਥਾਨ ਭਰਿਸਟੁ ਹੋਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: tatai taamas jaliohu mooRe thathai thaan bharisat hoaa ||
lines.translation: Tatta: In anger, you are burnt, you fool. T'hat'ha: That place where you live, is cursed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਘੈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਦਦੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਇਆ ॥੯॥
lines.transliteration: ghaghai ghar ghar phirahi too(n) mooRe dadai daan na tudh laiaa ||9||
lines.translation: Ghagha: You go begging from door to door, you fool. Dadda: But still, you do not receive the gift. ||9||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਪੈ ਪਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਵਹੀ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਰਪੰਚਿ ਤੂੰ ਪਲਚਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: papai paar na pavahee mooRe parapa(n)ch too(n) palach rahiaa ||
lines.translation: Pappa: You shall not be able to swim across, you fool, since you are engrossed in worldly affairs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਖੁਆਇਓਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਇਹੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਲੇਖੁ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: sachai aap khuaaiohu mooRe ihu sir terai lekh paiaa ||10||
lines.translation: The True Lord Himself has ruined you, you fool; this is the destiny written on your forehead. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਭੈ ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੁਬੋਹੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਗਲਤਾਨੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhabhai bhavajal dubohu mooRe maaiaa vich galataan bhaiaa ||
lines.translation: Bhabha: You have drowned in the terrifying world-ocean, you fool, and you have become engrossed in Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ ਏਕ ਘੜੀ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee eko jaanai ek ghaRee mahi paar paiaa ||11||
lines.translation: One who comes to know the One Lord, by Guru's Grace, is carried across in an instant. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਵੈ ਵਾਰੀ ਆਈਆ ਮੂੜੇ ਵਾਸੁਦੇਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਵੀਸਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vavai vaaree aaeeaa mooRe vaasudeu tudh veesariaa ||
lines.translation: Wawa: Your turn has come, you fool, but you have forgotten the Lord of Light.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹ ਵੇਲਾ ਨ ਲਹਸਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਤੂੰ ਜਮ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: eh velaa na lahasahi mooRe phir too(n) jam kai vas paiaa ||12||
lines.translation: This opportunity shall not come again, you fool; you shall fall under the power of the Messenger of Death. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਝੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਝੂਰਹਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਤੂੰ ਵਿਖਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhajhai kade na jhoorahi mooRe satigur kaa upades sun too(n) vikhaa ||
lines.translation: Jhajha: You shall never have to regret and repent, you fool, if you listen to the Teachings of the True Guru, for even an instant.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਾਝਹੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਨਾਉ ਬੁਰਾ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: satigur baajhahu gur nahee koee nigure kaa hai naau buraa ||13||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, there is no Guru at all; one who is without a Guru has a bad reputation. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਧੈ ਧਾਵਤ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਖੁ ਮੂੜੇ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਪਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhadhai dhaavat varaj rakh mooRe a(n)tar terai nidhaan paiaa ||
lines.translation: Dhadha: Restrain your wandering mind, you fool; deep within you the treasure is to be found.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਜੁਗਾ ਜੁਗੰਤਰਿ ਖਾਹਿ ਪਇਆ ॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hovahi taa har ras peevahi jugaa juga(n)tar khaahi paiaa ||14||
lines.translation: When one becomes Gurmukh, then he drinks in the sublime essence of the Lord; throughout the ages, he continues to drink it in. ||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਗੈ ਗੋਬਿਦੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਗਲੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gagai gobid chit kar mooRe galee kinai na paaiaa ||
lines.translation: Gagga: Keep the Lord of the Universe in your mind, you fool; by mere words, no one has ever attained Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਵਸਾਇ ਮੂੜੇ ਪਿਛਲੇ ਗੁਨਹ ਸਭ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਇਆ ॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: gur ke charan hiradai vasaai mooRe pichhale gunah sabh bakhas laiaa ||15||
lines.translation: Enshrine the Guru's feet within your heart, you fool, and all your past sins shall be forgiven. ||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਾਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਬੂਝੁ ਤੂੰ ਮੂੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: haahai har kathaa boojh too(n) mooRe taa sadaa sukh hoee ||
lines.translation: Haha: Understand the Lord's Sermon, you fool; only then shall you attain eternal peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਪੜਹਿ ਤੇਤਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਵਿਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧੬॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh paRahi tetaa dukh laagai vin satigur mukat na hoee ||16||
lines.translation: The more the self-willed manmukhs read, the more pain they suffer. Without the True Guru, liberation is not obtained. ||16||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਰੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮੂੜੇ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਜਿਨੑ ਕੈ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: raarai raam chit kar mooRe hiradai jinh kai rav rahiaa ||
lines.translation: Rarra: Center your consciousness on the Lord, you fool; abide with those whose hearts are filled with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਿਨੑੀ ਰਾਮੁ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਨਿਰਗੁਣ ਰਾਮੁ ਤਿਨੑੀ ਬੂਝਿ ਲਹਿਆ ॥੧੭॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jinhee raam pachhaataa niragun raam tinhee boojh lahiaa ||17||
lines.translation: By Guru's Grace, those who recognize the Lord, understand the absolute Lord. ||17||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲਖਿਆ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: teraa a(n)t na jaaee lakhiaa akath na jaaee har kathiaa ||
lines.translation: Your limits cannot be known; the indescribable Lord cannot be described.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨੑ ਕਉ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ॥੧੮॥੧॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jinh kau satigur miliaa tinh kaa lekhaa nibaRiaa ||18||1||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, whose who have met the True Guru, have their accounts settled. ||18||1||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਆਸਾ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag aasaa mahalaa 1 chha(n)t ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Aasaa, First Mehl, Chhant, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁੰਧ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲੜੀਏ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mu(n)dh joban baalaReee meraa pir raleeaalaa raam ||
lines.translation: O beautiful young bride, my Beloved Lord is very playful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਨੇਹੁ ਘਣਾ ਰਸਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan pir nehu ghanaa ras preet daiaalaa raam ||
lines.translation: When the bride enshrines great love for her Husband Lord, He becomes merciful, and loves her in return.
